items.q: Buster, Buster Wilson. I can't remember all their names. Some, a few of them are still there

ctx.x: I can't remember all of them. Buster, Buster Wilson. I can't remember all their names. Some, a few of them are still there, I doubt if they are still playing now.
Well when you, when you get through with Charlie Echols band, were you playing arrangements with Ellighe?
